description:
Use this when the user asks for the latest news on an Indian company, or what it has announced or filed recently: orders, board meetings, fundraising, acquisitions, management changes. It lists the company's own BSE disclosures, not media news.

Returns the company's BSE announcements, newest first: a readable `title`, category, filing time, a link to the PDF and a `news_id`. It lists filings and does not read them: pass `news_id` values to get_filing_extracts for their contents. `days` is 1 to 365 (default 30). `category` filters to one of: Company Update, Board Meeting, Corp. Action, AGM/EGM, Insider Trading / SAST, Integrated Filing, Others; any other value returns nothing. Announcements that attach the same document are shown once. The results announcement itself is not listed: the figures are in get_financials. A long list is cut to fit, with `truncated` set. Listing may queue a few of the filings for reading, which counts against the daily filing allowance.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
